source_text: 虚构活动“周末阅读角”：桌边一盏灯、一册书，安静、温暖，不使用真人或商标。

inputs.background: Modern London buildings may appear faintly in the distance, but must be de-emphasized
inputs.clouds: A few characteristically British stratus layers and soft cumulus, a slightly overcast feel, but never gloomy
inputs.easter_egg: Optionally hide one tiny minimalist red London double-decker bus silhouette as an easter egg, no larger than 1% of the frame
inputs.feel: Keep the feel of an architectural design archive; never drift into tourist cartoon illustration
inputs.hero_features: the gilded clock dial, the Gothic Revival spire, the finely detailed stone facade, the vertical window tracery, the crowning pinnacle
inputs.hero_identity: the tall rectangular tower shaft, the four large clock faces, the gilded clock-face ornament, the Gothic window tracery, the spire structure, the slender pinnacle
inputs.hero_palette: light sandstone, warm beige, grayish brown, low-saturation gold, deep gray-blue
inputs.hero_placement: Big Ben / Elizabeth Tower sits right of the visual center, the full tower clearly visible from its base to the spire tip, uncropped, with strictly true architectural proportions
inputs.hero_simplification: Simplify the complex Gothic structure into rectangles + thin vertical lines + triangles + pointed arches + ultra-fine geometric lines; render each clock face as a single restrained pale-gold circle; no thick black outlines
inputs.landmarks_line: Big Ben / Elizabeth Tower + Palace of Westminster + River Thames
inputs.lens: 50-85mm architectural photography, medium-telephoto compression, building verticals kept perfectly straight, no fisheye, no exaggerated wide-angle distortion
inputs.negative_extra: cartoon Big Ben, chibi London, children's book illustration, neon London, wrong Big Ben proportions, bent clock tower, missing clock face, incorrect Gothic structure, duplicated clock tower, London Eye stealing the subject, cheap tourist postcard style
inputs.quality: authentic London travel photography, premium architectural photography, cinematic golden hour, real stone texture, natural HDR, high dynamic range, 4K
inputs.rim_light: Sunlight passes through the clouds from behind the side, tracing a delicate golden rim light along Big Ben's edges
inputs.river: The broad River Thames fills the foreground, occupying about 20-25% of the photography area; the water is low-saturation blue-gray with fine natural ripples and slight building reflections
inputs.river_lines: A single ultra-fine deep gray-blue horizontal line beneath the buildings sets the baseline, with 5-7 ultra-thin horizontal lines of varying lengths below it in mist blue, gray-blue, and light navy, abstracting the Thames water surface
inputs.scale_reference: A single very small London tour boat may appear as a scale reference, but must not steal the subject
inputs.sky_gradient: a natural gradient from pale gray-blue to soft misty violet to light peach pink to faint warm gold
inputs.skyline: The Palace of Westminster stretches horizontally beside Big Ben, forming the classic London skyline; the buildings use real warm beige stone, with soft golden highlights where the setting sun strikes
inputs.subtitle: LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM
inputs.sun: A huge translucent geometric circle sun sits behind and slightly left of Big Ben, in very soft British mist pink / Dusty Rose / Pale Peach; the circle is partially occluded by Big Ben and the Palace; no realistic sun texture
inputs.supporting: A simplified Palace of Westminster extends horizontally to the left of Big Ben; the complex Gothic facade is highly geometricized, keeping only the row of spires, the rectangular main body, the towers, the pointed-arch windows, and the horizontal base; the building must be clearly lower than Big Ben
inputs.supporting_palette: beige-gray, sand, light brown, gray-blue, pale gold
inputs.time: London evening, golden hour transitioning into blue hour
inputs.viewpoint: Viewing the Palace of Westminster from near the south bank of the River Thames

output.example: 合成内容示例（供理解输出方向，未运行模型）：画面候选：以黄铜桌灯和打开的书为主体，保持无品牌；根据「ICONIC LANDMARK SERIES 城市地标海报」的风格与构图字段调整表现。这里只描述待生成画面，不展示或声称已经出图。

review_checks: 核对所有事实能在输入资料或已接受引用中找到。
核对输出满足 Fixed visual system (photo upper + vector lower + archival typography) city landmark poster prompt with fully parameterized city content
缺失或未确认信息必须明确标注；不得新增授权、执行或生产完成声明。
